title: Checkout service database migration failure
change: Added a database column migration and increased the database connection pool from 40 to 80 connections.
what_happened: Twenty minutes after deployment, checkout latency increased and approximately 18 percent of checkout requests timed out.
failed_fix: Increasing the connection pool from 80 to 120 connections did not solve the issue and increased database contention.
successful_fix: The team rolled back the application, paused the migration, later ran the migration separately, and deployed the application gradually beginning with 10 percent of production traffic.
lesson: Do not combine a database migration with a direct full-traffic deployment for checkout-service. Increasing the connection pool is not an effective fix for this failure pattern.

title: Checkout service staged migration success
change: Applied a database migration using a staged deployment approach.
what_happened: The migration was validated separately and the application was initially released to 10 percent of production traffic.
successful_fix: The team separated the migration from the application rollout, monitored connections and checkout latency, and increased traffic gradually.
lesson: For checkout-service releases involving database changes, use staged migration, connection monitoring, and gradual traffic shifting.
